codeSnippet:
type Box<T> = T extends any ? { val: T } : never;
type Result = Box<string | number>;

question.t: 請問 `Result` 的最終型別為何？這展示了 TypeScript 的哪種特性？
question.en: What is the final type of `Result`? Which TypeScript feature does this demonstrate?

options.t: `{ val: string | number }`；這是標準的泛型代入。
options.en: `{ val: string | number }`; this is standard generic substitution.

options.t: `{ val: string } | { val: number }`；這是分散式條件型別 (Distributive Conditional Types)。
options.en: `{ val: string } | { val: number }`; this is Distributive Conditional Types.

options.t: `never`；因為 `string | number` 不能同時滿足 `extends any`。
options.en: `never`; because `string | number` cannot satisfy `extends any` simultaneously.

options.t: `any`；因為條件判斷總是為真。
options.en: `any`; because the condition is always true.

why.t: 當泛型 `T` 為 Union Type 且位於條件型別 (Conditional Type) 的 `extends` 左側時，TypeScript 會觸發「分散式 (Distributive)」行為，將 Union 的每個成員單獨運算後再聯集 (Union) 結果。因此 `{ val: string } | { val: number }` 才是正確答案。
why.en: When generic `T` is a Union Type and appears on the left side of `extends` in a Conditional Type, TypeScript triggers 'Distributive' behavior. It computes each member of the Union individually and then unions the results. Thus, `{ val: string } | { val: number }` is the correct answer.

question.t: 關於上述程式碼中 `A` 與 `B` 的型別結果，下列敘述何者正確？
question.en: Regarding the type results of `A` and `B` in the code above, which statement is correct?

options.t: A 是 `boolean` (true | false)，B 是 `false`。
options.en: A is `boolean` (true | false), B is `false`.

options.t: A 是 `false`，B 是 `false`。
options.en: A is `false`, B is `false`.

options.t: A 是 `boolean`，B 是 `boolean`。
options.en: A is `boolean`, B is `boolean`.

options.t: A 是 `true`，B 是 `false`。
options.en: A is `true`, B is `false`.

why.t: Case A 觸發了分散式特性：`string` extends `string` (true) | `number` extends `string` (false)，結果為 `true | false` (即 `boolean`)。Case B 透過將泛型包裹在 Tuple `[T]` 中，關閉了分散式行為，將 `string | number` 視為一個整體，因為它不是 `string` 的子集，故結果為 `false`。
why.en: Case A triggers distributive behavior: `string` extends `string` (true) | `number` extends `string` (false), resulting in `true | false` (i.e., `boolean`). Case B disables distributive behavior by wrapping the generic in a Tuple `[T]`, treating `string | number` as a whole. Since it is not a subset of `string`, the result is `false`.

question.t: 這個 `Unpack` 工具型別使用了 `infer` 關鍵字。請問 `Res1` 與 `Res2` 的結果分別為何？
question.en: This `Unpack` utility type uses the `infer` keyword. What are the results of `Res1` and `Res2` respectively?

options.t: Res1: `string`, Res2: `number`
options.en: Res1: `string`, Res2: `number`

options.t: Res1: `string[]`, Res2: `number`
options.en: Res1: `string[]`, Res2: `number`

options.t: Res1: `string`, Res2: `() => number`
options.en: Res1: `string`, Res2: `() => number`

options.t: Res1: `unknown`, Res2: `unknown`
options.en: Res1: `unknown`, Res2: `unknown`

why.t: `Unpack` 透過巢狀條件判斷與 `infer` 來提取型別。第一層判斷 `T` 是否為陣列，若是則提取元素型別 `U` (Res1 為 string)。若否，第二層判斷 `T` 是否為函式，若是則提取回傳值 `R` (Res2 為 number)。
why.en: `Unpack` uses nested conditional checks and `infer` to extract types. The first check sees if `T` is an array and extracts element type `U` (Res1 is string). If not, the second check sees if `T` is a function and extracts return type `R` (Res2 is number).

question.t: 在 `CreateSetters` 中使用了 Key Remapping (`as` 語法)。請問 `string & K` 的作用是什麼？
question.en: Key Remapping (`as` syntax) is used in `CreateSetters`. What is the purpose of `string & K`?

options.t: 確保 `K` 是字串型別，因為 `keyof T` 可能包含 `number` 或 `symbol`，而 `Capitalize` 只接受字串。
options.en: To ensure `K` is a string type, because `keyof T` might contain `number` or `symbol`, and `Capitalize` only accepts strings.

options.t: 這是一個語法錯誤，應該直接使用 `Capitalize<K>`。
options.en: This is a syntax error; `Capitalize<K>` should be used directly.

options.t: 用來過濾掉 `User` 物件中的非字串屬性值。
options.en: To filter out non-string property values in the `User` object.

options.t: 將所有 key 強制轉換為小寫。
options.en: To force all keys to be converted to lowercase.

why.t: 在 TypeScript 中，物件的 key 可以是 `string | number | symbol`。然而，字串操作工具如 `Capitalize` 或 Template Literal Types 僅支援 `string`。使用 `string & K` 可以過濾掉非字串的 key (或將其視為 never 而被移除)，滿足型別約束。
why.en: In TypeScript, object keys can be `string | number | symbol`. However, string manipulation utilities like `Capitalize` or Template Literal Types only support `string`. Using `string & K` filters out non-string keys (or treats them as never, removing them) to satisfy type constraints.

question.t: 上述 `DeepPartial` 是一個常見的遞迴型別。在處理極度深層或巨大的物件結構時，可能會遇到什麼問題？
question.en: The `DeepPartial` above is a common recursive type. What issue might arise when processing extremely deep or huge object structures?

options.t: 會導致 Runtime Error，因為遞迴函式呼叫堆疊溢位。
options.en: It will cause a Runtime Error due to recursive function call stack overflow.

options.t: 會導致編譯錯誤 `Type instantiation is excessively deep and possibly infinite`。
options.en: It will cause a compilation error: `Type instantiation is excessively deep and possibly infinite`.

options.t: 不會有問題，TypeScript 的型別系統支援無限深度的遞迴。
options.en: No issue; TypeScript's type system supports infinite recursion depth.

options.t: 所有屬性會變成 `any`，失去型別檢查功能。
options.en: All properties will become `any`, losing type checking capabilities.

why.t: TypeScript 對於型別運算的遞迴深度有限制 (通常約 50 層)。過深的遞迴會觸發編譯器保護機制並報錯。這與 Runtime 無關，因為型別在編譯後就不存在了。
why.en: TypeScript has a limit on recursion depth for type operations (usually around 50 levels). Excessive recursion triggers a compiler safeguard and errors out. This is unrelated to Runtime, as types do not exist after compilation.

question.t: 當型別定義複雜時，IDE 往往只顯示 `A & B` 而非展開後的結構。下列哪個工具型別 (Utility Type) 常用來強制展開型別以利除錯？
question.en: When type definitions are complex, the IDE often shows `A & B` instead of the expanded structure. Which Utility Type pattern is commonly used to force type expansion for debugging?

options.t: `type Expand<T> = T extends infer O ? { [K in keyof O]: O[K] } : never;`
options.en: `type Expand<T> = T extends infer O ? { [K in keyof O]: O[K] } : never;`

options.t: `type Expand<T> = T;`
options.en: `type Expand<T> = T;`

options.t: `type Expand<T> = Partial<T>;`
options.en: `type Expand<T> = Partial<T>;`

options.t: `type Expand<T> = keyof T;`
options.en: `type Expand<T> = keyof T;`

why.t: 這個模式利用 `infer O` 捕捉當前型別，並透過 Mapped Type `{ [K in keyof O]: O[K] }` 重新建立一個物件結構。這會強迫 TypeScript 計算並展平 (flatten) 所有的 Intersection，讓 IDE 能顯示最終的屬性列表。
why.en: This pattern uses `infer O` to capture the current type and reconstructs an object structure via Mapped Type `{ [K in keyof O]: O[K] }`. This forces TypeScript to compute and flatten all Intersections, allowing the IDE to display the final property list.

why.t: 這是一個遞迴的樣板字面值型別 (Recursive Template Literal Type)。第一次推斷提取出 `postId`，剩餘字串為 `/comments/:commentId`；遞迴呼叫後提取出 `commentId`。最終結果為兩者的 Union。
why.en: This is a Recursive Template Literal Type. The first inference extracts `postId`, leaving `/comments/:commentId`; the recursive call then extracts `commentId`. The final result is the Union of both.

question.t: 在 Mapped Types 中使用 `-` 修飾符的作用為何？請問 `Result` 的型別是什麼？
question.en: What is the effect of the `-` modifier in Mapped Types? What is the type of `Result`?

options.t: { id: number; name: string; } (移除了 readonly 與 optional)
options.en: { id: number; name: string; } (Removes readonly and optional)

options.t: { readonly id: number; name?: string; } (無變化)
options.en: { readonly id: number; name?: string; } (No change)

options.t: { id?: number; readonly name: string; } (反轉修飾符)
options.en: { id?: number; readonly name: string; } (Inverts modifiers)

options.t: Error: 語法錯誤
options.en: Error: Syntax error

answer: { id: number; name: string; } (移除了 readonly 與 optional)

why.t: 在 Mapped Types 中，`-readonly` 會移除唯讀屬性，`-?` 會移除可選屬性 (Optional)，使所有屬性變為必填且可寫入。
why.en: In Mapped Types, `-readonly` removes the readonly attribute, and `-?` removes the optional attribute, making all properties required and mutable.

question.t: 根據集合論 (Set Theory) 視角，`never` 在 Union Type 中扮演什麼角色？`Result` 的結果為何？
question.en: From a Set Theory perspective, what role does `never` play in a Union Type? What is the result of `Result`?

options.t: never 是空集合，在 Union 中會被自動移除。Result 為 `number`。
options.en: never is the empty set and is automatically removed in a Union. Result is `number`.

options.t: never 代表錯誤，Result 會變成 `never`。
options.en: never represents an error, so Result becomes `never`.

options.t: never 會被保留。Result 為 `number | never`。
options.en: never is preserved. Result is `number | never`.

options.t: Result 為 `string | boolean` (反向篩選)。
options.en: Result is `string | boolean` (Inverse filtering).

answer: never 是空集合，在 Union 中會被自動移除。Result 為 `number`。

why.t: 在 TypeScript 的集合論模型中，`never` 代表空集合 (Empty Set)。任何型別 `T | never` 都等同於 `T`，因此它常用於 Conditional Types 中來「過濾」掉不符合條件的型別。
why.en: In TypeScript's set theory model, `never` represents the Empty Set. Any type `T | never` is equivalent to `T`, so it is commonly used in Conditional Types to 'filter out' types that do not meet the condition.

question.t: 在設計泛型工具或型別體操時，為何應避免使用 `any` (例如 `T extends any`)，而推薦使用 `unknown`？
question.en: When designing generic utilities or performing type gymnastics, why should you avoid using `any` (e.g., `T extends any`) and prefer `unknown`?

options.t: `any` 會關閉型別檢查並傳染給後續的推導，破壞型別安全；`unknown` 則是型別安全的頂層型別。
options.en: `any` disables type checking and propagates to subsequent inferences, breaking type safety; `unknown` is the type-safe top type.

options.t: `any` 不能用於 `extends` 語法，會導致編譯錯誤。
options.en: `any` cannot be used in `extends` syntax and will cause a compilation error.

options.t: `unknown` 的效能比 `any` 好，能加速 TypeScript 編譯。
options.en: `unknown` has better performance than `any` and speeds up TypeScript compilation.

options.t: 兩者完全相同，只是命名風格不同。
options.en: They are exactly the same, just different naming styles.

answer: `any` 會關閉型別檢查並傳染給後續的推導，破壞型別安全；`unknown` 則是型別安全的頂層型別。

why.t: `any` 是型別系統的逃生門，一旦使用，後續依賴它的推導通常也會變成 `any` (Pollution)。`unknown` 強制使用者在使用前進行型別檢查或限縮，能維持嚴格的推導鏈。
why.en: `any` is an escape hatch from the type system; once used, subsequent inferences depending on it usually become `any` (Pollution). `unknown` forces the user to perform type checks or narrowing before use, maintaining a strict inference chain.

codeSnippet:
type T1 = { id: number } & { name: string };
type T2 = string & number;

question.t: 關於 `&` (Intersection) 運算子的行為，下列敘述何者正確？
question.en: Regarding the behavior of the `&` (Intersection) operator, which of the following statements is true?

options.t: T1 為 `{ id: number; name: string }`，T2 為 `never`。
options.en: T1 is `{ id: number; name: string }`, T2 is `never`.

options.t: T1 為 `{ id: number; name: string }`，T2 為 `any`。
options.en: T1 is `{ id: number; name: string }`, T2 is `any`.

options.t: T1 為 `never` (因為物件結構不同)，T2 為 `never`。
options.en: T1 is `never` (because object structures differ), T2 is `never`.

options.t: T1 與 T2 都是合法的聯集型別 (Union Types)。
options.en: Both T1 and T2 are valid Union Types.

answer: T1 為 `{ id: number; name: string }`，T2 為 `never`。

why.t: 物件的交集會合併其屬性 (T1)；但基本型別 (Primitives) 的交集若無重疊 (如字串與數字不可能同時存在)，結果為空集合 `never`。
why.en: The intersection of objects merges their properties (T1); however, the intersection of primitives with no overlap (like string and number cannot exist simultaneously) results in the empty set `never`.
